process PLINK_HOMOZYG {
    tag "${meta.id}"
    label 'process_single'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/59/5901c2e9a6b11094536c8b0ab0932bd61bb55dbfe9ad270d3babc8f7246a4759/data'
        : 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/plink:1.90b6.21--0baa44af6db8f28d'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(bed), path(bim), path(fam)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.hom"), emit: hom
    tuple val(meta), path("*.hom.indiv"), emit: hom_indiv
    tuple val(meta), path("*.hom.summary"), emit: hom_summary
    tuple val(meta), path("*.log"), emit: log
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('plink'), eval("plink --version 2>&1 | sed 's/^PLINK v//;s/ .*//'"), emit: versions_plink, topic: versions

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    plink \\
        --homozyg \\
        --bed ${bed} \\
        --bim ${bim} \\
        --fam ${fam} \\
        ${args} \\
        --threads ${task.cpus} \\
        --out ${prefix}_ROH
    """

    stub:
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    touch ${prefix}_ROH.hom ${prefix}_ROH.hom.indiv ${prefix}_ROH.hom.summary ${prefix}_ROH.log
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/plink/homozyg"
description: "Runs of homozygosity (ROH) detection with PLINK 1.9 (--homozyg)"
keywords:
- "roh"
- "homozyg"
- "plink"
- "inbreeding"
tools:
- plink:
    description: "Whole genome association analysis toolset."
    homepage: "https://www.cog-genomics.org/plink"
    documentation: "https://www.cog-genomics.org/plink/1.9/"
    licence:
    - "GPL"
    identifier: "biotools:plink"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information"
  - bed:
      type: "file"
      description: "PLINK binary genotype table"
      pattern: "*.bed"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3003"
  - bim:
      type: "file"
      description: "PLINK variant table"
      pattern: "*.bim"
  - fam:
      type: "file"
      description: "PLINK sample table"
      pattern: "*.fam"
output:
  hom:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information"
    - '*.hom':
        type: "file"
        description: "ROH segments, one line per segment"
        pattern: "*.hom"
  hom_indiv:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information"
    - '*.hom.indiv':
        type: "file"
        description: "ROH totals per individual"
        pattern: "*.hom.indiv"
  hom_summary:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information"
    - '*.hom.summary':
        type: "file"
        description: "ROH summary statistics"
        pattern: "*.hom.summary"
  log:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information"
    - '*.log':
        type: "file"
        description: "PLINK log"
        pattern: "*.log"
  versions_plink:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The process the versions were collected from"
    - plink:
        type: "string"
        description: "The tool name"
    - plink --version 2>&1 | sed 's/^PLINK v//;s/ .*//':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The process the versions were collected from"
    - plink:
        type: "string"
        description: "The tool name"
    - plink --version 2>&1 | sed 's/^PLINK v//;s/ .*//':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
